description: Every Dropsuite (NinjaOne SaaS Backup) read, plus fleet-wide backup health, coverage gaps and billing reconciliation from one reseller credential.

env_var_specs.name: DROPSUITE_ACCESS_TOKEN
env_var_specs.description: Authentication Token from Settings > API Settings (the reseller admin token), sent as X-Access-Token.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: List an organization's backed-up mailboxes with their backup status and last backup. Wire format: GET /api/accounts with optional email, username and backup_status query filters, sent with the organization's own token (use --org); the response is a bare JSON array. Each row has last_backup, current_backup_status (observed values Completed, Running, Preparing Backup, Connecting, Connection Failed), storage, msg_count and deactivated_since; the nested user object carries masked credentials. Optional: email, username, backup_status. Returns array of MailAccount.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

params.name: username
params.description: Filter by account username.

params.name: backup_status
params.description: Filter by backup status.

tools.name: accounts_list-connection-failures
tools.description: List an organization's mailboxes whose backup cannot connect to the mail server. Wire format: GET /api/accounts/connection_failures; the response is an object with result_set, pagination (current_page, per_page, total_entries, total_pages) and api_version. Returns the ConnectionFailures.

tools.name: accounts_list-deactivated
tools.description: List an organization's mailboxes whose backup is deactivated. Wire format: GET /api/accounts/deactivated_accounts with an optional email query filter; the response is a bare JSON array with deactivated_since set. Optional: email. Returns array of MailAccount.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

tools.name: accounts_list-deleted
tools.description: List an organization's mailboxes that were deleted from backup. Wire format: GET /api/accounts/deleted_accounts with an optional email query filter; the response is a bare JSON array with flg_deleted true. Optional: email. Returns array of MailAccount.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

tools.name: accounts_list-invites
tools.description: Show the pending backup invitation sent to a mailbox owner. It includes who requested it, when it was last sent and whether it expired. Wire format: GET /api/accounts/invites with an optional email query filter; the vendor's sample response is a single invite object. Optional: email. Returns the Invite.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

tools.name: calendars_list
tools.description: List an organization's calendar backups per mailbox. Wire format: GET /api/calendars with optional email, page and backup_status query parameters (at most 25 rows per page); the response is a bare JSON array with calendar_schedule_count, last_backup and current_backup_status. Optional: email, page, backup_status. Returns array of CalendarBackup.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: backup_status
params.description: Filter by backup status.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: List an organization's contact backups per mailbox. Wire format: GET /api/contacts with optional email, page and backup_status query parameters (at most 25 rows per page); the response is a bare JSON array with contact_count, last_backup and current_backup_status. Optional: email, page, backup_status. Returns array of ContactBackup.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: backup_status
params.description: Filter by backup status.

tools.name: google_drives_list
tools.description: List an organization's backed-up Google Drives. Wire format: GET /api/googledrives with an optional page query parameter; the response is a bare JSON array with file_count, storage, last_backup and drive type. Optional: page. Returns array of GoogleDriveBackup.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1 (the vendor types it as a string on this route).

tools.name: journals_get
tools.description: Get the archiver journal mailbox of an organization (Archiver product only). Wire format: GET /api/journals; the response is an object with id and email. Returns the Journal.

tools.name: journals_get-ndr
tools.description: Get the NDR (non-delivery report) journal mailbox of an organization. Wire format: GET /api/ndr_journals; the response is an object with id and email. Returns the Journal.

tools.name: onedrives_list
tools.description: List an organization's backed-up OneDrive accounts with file counts and last backup. Wire format: GET /api/onedrives with optional email, page and backup_status query parameters (at most 25 rows per page); the response is a bare JSON array with file_count, storage, last_backup, last_activity and current_backup_status. Optional: email, page, backup_status. Returns array of OneDriveBackup.

params.name: email
params.description: Filter by the organization owner's email or one backed-up email address.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: backup_status
params.description: Filter by backup status.

tools.name: organizations_get
tools.description: Get one organization's subscription, including the seat counters used for billing. Wire format: GET /api/users/{id} with the reseller's own Authentication Token. Fields include seats_used, seats_available, active_seats, required_seats, deactivated_seats, paid_shared_mailboxes, free_shared_mailboxes and auto_license. Ids look like 26561-14 on current deployments. Required: id. Returns the Organization.

params.name: id
params.description: Organization (tenant user) id from the organizations list, for example 26561-14.

tools.name: organizations_get-support-sso-link
tools.description: Generate a portal sign-in link for one user email, using the reseller's own token. Wire format: GET /api/users/generate_support_sso_link with a required email query parameter; the response is an object with redirect_url. The URL is a login credential; treat it as a secret. Required: email. Returns the RedirectLink.

params.name: email
params.description: Email of the user to sign in as.

tools.name: organizations_list
tools.description: List every client organization (tenant user) under the reseller, with seats and storage counters. Wire format: GET /api/users with optional email and external_id query filters, sent with the reseller's own Authentication Token; the response is a bare JSON array. Dropsuite calls organizations users. The authentication_token and reseller_token fields are credentials and are masked in output. Optional: email, external_id. Returns array of Organization.

params.name: email
params.description: Scope the result to the organization whose owner email matches.

params.name: external_id
params.description: Scope the result to the organization with this external (billing system) id.

tools.name: organizations_list-delegated-users
tools.description: List an organization's delegated portal users and their roles. Delegated users can sign in to the end-user portal although their own mailbox is not backed up; each row has role, login_enabled and activated. Wire format: GET /api/users/{id}/delegated with page and per_page query parameters, sent with that organization's own token (the CLI resolves it); the response is a pagination envelope with a data array. dropsuite.us serves it; the older regional hosts answer HTML 404. Required: id. Optional: page, per_page. Returns array of DelegatedUser.

params.name: id
params.description: Organization (tenant user) id from the organizations list, for example 26561-14.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 100 (server default 100).

tools.name: organizations_list-retention-policies
tools.description: List an organization's retention policies. Each policy says how long items are kept (period_number with period_unit days, months or years) and which items it covers. Wire format: GET /api/users/{id}/retention_policies with type, page and per_page query parameters, sent with that organization's own token (the CLI resolves it); the response is a pagination envelope with a data array. dropsuite.us serves it; the older regional hosts answer HTML 404. Required: id. Optional: type, page, per_page. Returns array of RetentionPolicy.

params.name: id
params.description: Organization (tenant user) id from the organizations list, for example 26561-14.

params.name: type
params.description: Retention policy type (case-sensitive). The vendor reference lists default_domain, email_account, all_email_accounts, department, saved_search, message, review process, site and all sites; samples show review_process.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 100 (server default 100).

tools.name: organizations_list-tenant-accounts
tools.description: List a tenant's mailboxes and whether each is backed up, available to add, or excluded. Use status=available to find unprotected mailboxes. Wire format: GET /api/users/{id}/tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts with a required type (m365 or gws) and optional status, page and per_page query parameters, sent with that organization's own token (the CLI resolves it); the response is a pagination envelope with a data array. The vendor reference lists this route without the tenant segment, but the live route includes it. dropsuite.us serves it; the older regional hosts answer HTML 404. Required: id, tenant_id, type. Optional: status, page, per_page. Returns array of TenantAccount.

params.name: id
params.description: Organization (tenant user) id from the organizations list, for example 26561-14.

params.name: tenant_id
params.description: Tenant id from the organization tenants list.

params.name: type
params.description: Tenant type, m365 or gws (case-sensitive).

params.name: status
params.description: Mailbox backup status, excluded, active or available.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 100 (server default 100).

tools.name: organizations_list-tenants
tools.description: List an organization's Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace tenants. Each tenant has its domain, a status code and total_users. Wire format: GET /api/users/{id}/tenants with type (m365 or gws), page and per_page query parameters, sent with that organization's own token (the CLI resolves it); the response is a pagination envelope with a data array. Status codes: 0 queued, 1 and 13 recreate application, 7 completed. dropsuite.us serves it; the older regional hosts answer HTML 404. Required: id. Optional: type, page, per_page. Returns array of Tenant.

params.name: id
params.description: Organization (tenant user) id from the organizations list, for example 26561-14.

params.name: type
params.description: Tenant type, m365 or gws (case-sensitive).

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 100 (server default 100).

tools.name: portal_get-hosted-exchange-status
tools.description: Get the status of a hosted Exchange PowerShell connection request. The request id comes from the vendor's POST /users/hosted_exchange, which this read-only CLI does not call. Wire format: GET /api/users/hosted_exchange with a required exchange_request_id query parameter. Required: exchange_request_id. Returns the HostedExchangeStatus.

params.name: exchange_request_id
params.description: Exchange request id.

tools.name: portal_get-login-link
tools.description: Generate a single-use portal sign-in URL for an organization, for example to run a restore test. The link expires after 30 minutes, works once, and each call invalidates the previous link; it is a login credential. Wire format: GET /api/users/generate_redirect_link with an optional role query parameter; the response is an object with redirect_url. Optional: role. Returns the RedirectLink.

params.name: role
params.description: Optional portal role (documented only as a string). The role values the vendor lists for its per-organization SSO link are full_admin, it_admin, restricted_it_admin, group_admin, user, user_read_only, reviewer, limited_reviewer, dpo and a compliance officer role; whether this endpoint accepts the same values is not documented.

tools.name: portal_list-sub-users
tools.description: List the sub-users who can sign in to an organization's portal, with their role. Wire format: GET /api/users/sub_users; the response is a bare JSON array with email and current_role (for example User View And Restore). The authentication_token field is a credential and is masked in output. Returns array of SubUser.

tools.name: reference_list-countries
tools.description: List the countries Dropsuite accepts. Wire format: GET /api/countries; only X-Reseller-Token is required; the response is a bare JSON array. Returns array of Country.

tools.name: reference_list-locales
tools.description: List the portal languages as a map of language name to locale code (for example english to en). Wire format: GET /api/locales; only X-Reseller-Token is required. Returns the ReferenceListLocalesResponse.

tools.name: reference_list-timezones
tools.description: List the time zones Dropsuite accepts. Wire format: GET /api/timezones; only X-Reseller-Token is required; the response is a bare JSON array. Returns array of Timezone.

tools.name: server_get-status
tools.description: Check that the Dropsuite API server is up. Wire format: GET /api/status; the response body is the JSON string OK. The dropsuite.us host answers without credentials; the older regional hosts answer 401 without credentials.

tools.name: shared_drive_backups_list
tools.description: List the backup runs of one Google shared drive. Wire format: GET /api/shareddrives/domains/{id}/drives/{drive_id}/backups with an optional page query parameter; the response is a bare JSON array with start_time, end_time, total_files, current_num_file, a numeric status, backup_storage and retries. Required: id, drive_id. Optional: page. Returns array of SharedDriveBackup.

params.name: id
params.description: Shared drive domain id.

params.name: drive_id
params.description: Shared drive id from the shared drives list.

params.name: page

tools.name: shared_drive_domains_list

Wire format: GET /api/shareddrives/domains with optional domain_name and page query parameters; the response is a bare JSON array with file_count, storage and last_backup. Optional: domain_name, page. Returns array of SharedDriveDomain.

params.name: domain_name
params.description: Scope the result to one domain name.

params.name: page

tools.name: shared_drives_list-in-domain
tools.description: List the shared drives in one Google Workspace domain. Wire format: GET /api/shareddrives/domains/{id}/drives with optional drive_name and page query parameters; the response is a bare JSON array with sd_drive, active, file_count, storage and last_backup. Required: id. Optional: drive_name, page. Returns array of SharedDrive.

params.name: id
params.description: Shared drive domain id from the shared drive domains list.

params.name: drive_name
params.description: Filter by shared drive name.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, starting at 1 (the vendor types it as a string on this route).

params.name: page

params.name: site_name

params.name: page

params.name: backup_status

tools.name: tasks_list

Wire format: GET /api/tasks with optional email, page and backup_status query parameters (at most 25 rows per page); the response is a bare JSON array with task_count, last_backup and current_backup_status. Optional: email, page, backup_status. Returns array of TaskBackup.

params.name: email

params.name: page

params.name: backup_status

tools.description: List the backed-up Teams and Microsoft 365 Groups in one domain. novel_features.name: Fleet backup health
novel_features.description: See every failed, stuck or stale mailbox, OneDrive, SharePoint site, Team, shared drive and Google Drive across your active clients in one run.

novel_features.name: Coverage gaps
novel_features.description: List mailboxes that exist in each client's Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace tenant but are not added to backup, with coverage percent per client.

novel_features.name: Billing and seat reconciliation
novel_features.description: Compare each client's seat counters and shared mailboxes with what your PSA invoices, and flag over-allocation and suspended clients still holding seats.

novel_features.name: Restore-readiness evidence pack
novel_features.description: Produce one client's dated proof of protection: coverage, last successful backups, item counts, retention policies, freshness history and recorded restore tests.

novel_features.name: Lifecycle hygiene
novel_features.description: Find deactivated or deleted mailboxes still holding storage and invitations nobody accepted, across every client.

novel_features.name: Restore-test ledger
novel_features.description: Record the result of a restore test you performed in the portal and see which clients are due for one.

novel_features.name: Locate a user across clients
novel_features.description: Find which client owns an email address, whether its mailbox and OneDrive are protected, and when they last backed up.

novel_features.name: Snapshot drift
novel_features.description: See what changed between health runs: objects that left backup, backups that stopped advancing and item-count drops.
